test_MiniSWERunner: test the MiniSWERunner class with a kimi model forcing a fixed temperature of 0.6
test_MiniSWERunner_moonshot: test the MiniSWERunner class with a moonshot kimi-k2.5 model forcing a fixed temperature of 1.0
run_MiniSWERunner_task: run a single task with MiniSWERunner using local environment and max iterations of 1
create_MiniSWERunner: create a MiniSWERunner instance with model, base_url, api_key, env_type, and max_iterations
build_batch_runner: build a batch runner that executes multiple prompts and saves trajectories to a JSONL file
